claim_assertions.unrealized_exceeds_net_gain: The current-year unrealized equity gain exceeds the total pretax investment gain.
claim_assertions.parent_income_is_cf_start: Parent-attributable earnings are the starting net earnings of the consolidated operating-cash bridge.
claim_assertions.exact_float_cost_identified: The year-end float stocks identify an exact annual cost of float.

definitions.parent_earnings_bridge: After-tax parent scope for three years. Operating earnings remove signed investment gains and signed equity-method impairments from parent income.
definitions.consolidated_cash_bridge: Consolidated scope for three years. Add all signed statement adjustments to consolidated net earnings. Noncontrolling income is consolidated less parent income.
definitions.investment_gain_bridge: Pretax scope for three years. Net fixed gains combine realized gains and losses. Compare component total with the signed cash-flow removal and report unrealized equity gain divided by net pretax investment gain.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient facts and relevant period, unit, definition or scope context for each output. Additional unrelated sections fail evidence. Equivalent reviewed source paths are accepted, without a shortest-citation requirement.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
